plan.major: Media Arts and Sciences (Interdisciplinary Arts and Performance)
plan.notes: Source: official ASU Degree Search major map for 'Media Arts and Sciences (Interdisciplinary Arts and Performance), BA' (program code HIDCIAPBA), 2024-2025 catalog year: https://degrees.asu.edu/major-map/ASU00/HIDCIAPBA/null/ALL/2024 . Transcription method: automated parse of every term row (courses, credit hours, minimum grades) from the official major map page on 2026-09-30, spot-checked against the rendered page. Term names use ASU's own 'Term N' numbering. General Studies designations (HUAD, SOBE, SCIT, AMIT, GCSI, CIVI, SUST) are modeled as choice:true student-choice slots; OR-options are choice slots naming the alternatives. Per-course prerequisites are NOT listed on the ASU major map, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty. Campus: Tempe. Major map track groups (Media Arts and Sciences Flexible Elective, Media Engineering Course List, Interdisciplinary Arts and Performance Concentration Course List, Digital Media Course List, Media Arts and Sciences Studies Course List) are elective choice lists referenced from term slots; transcribed as choice slots with the group's courses as options.
